summary: A hidden or secret place, including the inward place of the heart.

senses.definition: The psalmist asks for truth in the hidden place of the heart.

note: The closed place in Psalm 51:8 is the noun sense of סתם. Arabic صَتَمَ means to be locked or have no exit. The filename setam avoids collision with satam, the separate root שׂטמ.
